subject.title: fix(sessions): add try-catch wrappers around unprotected JSON.parse calls in session-accessor.sqlite.ts

question: What is the canonical runtime policy when a current-schema SQLite transcript row contains malformed JSON?
rationale: The repository treats transcript rows as canonical persistent user state and forbids adding silent fallback behavior without an explicit product decision; code review cannot choose whether runtime should stop, quarantine, or omit that state.

options.title: Fail closed and repair
options.body: Return an explicit corruption result, keep the transcript unchanged, and direct the operator to a tested Doctor repair or quarantine flow.

options.title: Quarantine malformed rows
options.body: Atomically quarantine malformed rows with durable diagnostics while preserving event-row identity and making the incomplete transcript visible to callers.

options.title: Accept silent omission
options.body: Intentionally allow runtime reads to hide malformed events, accepting partial transcript loss and weakened identity guarantees.

recommendation.title: Fail closed and repair
recommendation.body: Return an explicit corruption result, keep the transcript unchanged, and direct the operator to a tested Doctor repair or quarantine flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The session-accessor and transcript-reader seam history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing its corruption contract.
